pure-announcement.rationale: It is the full self-contained text of a format specification, not a launch, release or funding notice.

duplicate.rationale: Agent Skills format is the closest neighbour but covers a packaging format for skills, not OKF's provenance, trust-tier and attestation model for agent-maintained knowledge bundles.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The note is itself the primary source — a versioned public spec whose conformance rules and worked examples a reader can check directly.

durability.rationale: Field names may churn between 0.x revisions, but the design trade-offs it argues — record credibility signals not scores, derive trust tiers from verifier actors, keyed footnotes because agents reorder lists, absolute stale_after instants, deterministic attesters over receipts — are mechanisms that stay useful regardless of OKF's own adoption.

actionability.rationale: Anyone building an agent-maintained corpus can adopt its frontmatter families and conformance rules verbatim, and its rationales directly change how one would design provenance and staleness in any comparable system.

atomicity.rationale: The spec bundles two separable promotable ideas — the minimal markdown-plus-frontmatter bundle convention with its trust and provenance families, and the attested-computation pattern (sanctioned computation, receipt, no-LLM attester) that stands on its own outside OKF.
